title: Q-FLEETMAP-what-works: ultrastable/what-works is not equal to its source (5 file(s) differ, 5 missing, 0 only in the copy)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe what-works
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** open

ultrastable/what-works is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): 5 file(s) differ, 5 missing, 0 only in the copy.

- differ: lifecycle.json, vendor/ultrastable/kgraph.js, vendor/ultrastable/tenant-standard.json, vendor/ultrastable/tools/tenantstd.py, vendor/ultrastable/tools/vendor_sync.mjs
- missing: vendor/ultrastable/autonomy/repo-conformance.json, vendor/ultrastable/standards/system.schema.json, vendor/ultrastable/tools/deprot.py, vendor/ultrastable/tools/repoconform.py, vendor/ultrastable/tools/surfaces.py
- ultrastable.json is in the older tenant-standard shape (runs_as as one object, no visibility); the schema is seed/standards/system.schema.json

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe what-works
